title: The Crypt Door, Open
text: In the morning the crypt door is found open, swinging a little on its hinges. It was barred from outside, and the bar lies unbroken on the steps; it was opened from within. In the dust on the stairs, narrow bare footprints come up.

options.label: Go down and count the dead to learn which of them walked.

outcomes.text: All the dead are where they were laid. One of them has turned to face the door.
One coffin is empty. The name on it is your founder's.

options.label: Seal the crypt with iron and salt so nothing else comes up.

outcomes.text: The bars hold. Now and then, something taps on them politely.

options.label: Leave it open, and set a place at table for whoever comes up.

outcomes.text: The House's dead are grateful. Old skills return to the living in dreams.
The House's dead are hungry. By morning the larder is bare, and the dogs will not come inside.
